answer: Dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect punishment matrices, secured by zero-knowledge verifiable delay, form cryptoeconomic primitives against forgery. Mandating staking collateral and slashing penalties builds an economic jetty isolating adversaries from the ocean of honest nodes, ensuring Sybil multiplication yields strictly negative payoff since forfeited nectar cannot offset bond losses. This capital barrier forces rational agents to internalize risks, converging the system into a robust Nash equilibrium where deviation yields inferior utility.
